# Alder Runner native-launch inputs

## Scope

Explain the current supported hosts and accepted argument inputs of Alder Runner's native-launch API so callers can decide whether and how to use that API.

## When to update

Update when the publisher changes the current supported-host matrix or accepted argument forms.

## Current contract

The current release supports Windows and Linux hosts. macOS hosts are unsupported. Each supplied argument must be a nonempty Unicode string; empty arguments are rejected. Callers must check that every target host and intended argument meets this API's current contract before choosing it.

installed_routes.condition: Choosing or explaining the native-launch API

The publisher may change the current-release matrix and accepted argument forms in later releases. The leaf is intended to track the current release, not freeze a historical one.
